blk_part_01_vilnius_old_town_and_cepelin.text: Your trip starts in Vilnius, the capital of Lithuania. You walk through the Old Town. The streets are small, and there are old churches everywhere. This Old Town is very old, and it is also very big. Many of its buildings and streets are hundreds of years old. Because of this, UNESCO put it on its World Heritage list. UNESCO is a world group that takes care of very important places.

blk_part_01_vilnius_old_town_and_cepelin.text: At lunch, you go into Etno Dvaras, a restaurant with food from Lithuania. You order cepelinai, the national dish of Lithuania. Cepelinai are big potato dumplings. A dumpling is a soft ball of food with more food inside. Inside cepelinai, there is usually meat or curd cheese, a soft white cheese. On top, there is a sauce of sour cream with small pieces of bacon.

A small group of Karaim people still lives in Trakai today.
